title: A refusal tells you where to look
goal: {{cast.operator}} gets a report that {{cast.agent}} "does not work" and needs to find the cause quickly.
obstacle: Most refusals look alike from the agent's side: a status code and a short body.
control: Each check refuses with its own status code, so the code points at the check that said no.

steps.title: Read the status
steps.say: 401 is the key, 403 is scope or grant, 429 is a limit, 400 is the guardrail.

steps.title: Check the grant first
steps.tell: For a bare 403, {{cast.operator}} checks that {{cast.app}} is selected on {{cast.key}}.
steps.say: Most reports of a broken agent turn out to be a grant that was never made.

steps.title: Look at the key, not the app
steps.tell: For a 400, {{cast.operator}} opens the guardrail events for {{cast.key}}.
steps.say: The block is working as designed. Check the key's guardrail events before blaming the app.
